title: JUST OPENED?
*GET ON GOOGLE*
IN 5 STEPS
slides.sub: What to do in your first month so locals find you.

title: THE SIGN IS UP.
*GOOGLE HAS NO IDEA.*
slides.body: Tom opens a café in Subiaco on Monday. On Tuesday, someone two doors down searches "coffee near me". Tom's café doesn't show up.

title: SET UP YOUR
*GOOGLE PROFILE*
slides.body: Your Google Business Profile is your listing on Google Maps. Your website can wait a month. This profile can't.

title: MATCH THE NAME
*TO YOUR SIGN*
slides.body: Google checks your profile name against your shop sign. "Tom's Café Best Coffee Perth" (solid headline right there) fails. "Tom's Café" passes.

title: FILM THE
*CHECK VIDEO*
slides.body: Google asks most new businesses for a short video. Film it at your shop, from the street sign to opening your front door.

title: PICK YOUR
*MAIN CATEGORY*
ONCE
slides.body: Your main category tells Google what you do. A Midland electrician picks "Electrician". Change it later and Google can ask you to verify again.

title: ASK YOUR FIRST
*10 CUSTOMERS*
slides.body: Ask your first ten customers for a Google review before they walk out. Your competitors have years of reviews. You start at zero.

title: *RECAP*
items: Set up your Google profile now
Use the name on your sign
Film the video at your shop

title: WANT A
*FREE AUDIT?*
slides.body: Send us a DM and I'll check your Google profile for free.
